items.prompt: Which word is the mubtadaʾ here?
items.explanation: Al-kitābu starts the sentence and is spoken about: it is the mubtadaʾ.

items.prompt: In the view most books follow, what makes the mubtadaʾ marfūʿ?
options: Its standing at the start (ibtidāʾ), a governor of meaning
items.explanation: The mubtadaʾ has no governor in the words; its being at the start governs it.
The sentence tells something about what the listener knows, so the mubtadaʾ is usually definite.
